note: Absolute gates are program §4.12; regression tolerances are the gate policy in docs/ask-reel-eval.md. Pre-registered 2026-10-24 before the 99c0761 baseline ran; every change made after any baseline data existed is listed in `amendments` with its reason. Change them only by a reviewed commit, never to make a run pass.

gates.label: Missed supply (no pick while eligible titles clear the bar)
Supply counts equal the SQL truth (none-found replies)
Standing-exclusion leaks (shown titles outside the eligibility truth)
Picks against the request's own media filter
Trakt calls from the eval stack

amendments.change: fallback: a WhySource counts only when it is a typed fallback (Fallback, Stub), not any non-model source
amendments.reason: v1 stores WhySource=Generic on the captionless filmography list by design, and Templater on outside-request cards whose caption is the deterministic statement of the exclusion they trip (all 36 Templater cards in the 99c0761 open recording are outsideRequest=true). Neither is a failed model call. Effect on the open baseline: fallback rate 0.677 → 0.623.

amendments.change: (1) wrong-media picks moved out of exclusionLeaks into mediaMismatches; (2) a reply names a title only with the title's own capitalisation and not made of common words alone
amendments.reason: (1) a wrong-media pick answers the user's words, not a standing exclusion — conflating them made the leak count mostly media (leaks 160 → 66); (2) prose such as 'the other one' matched the films The Other / In and Out (grounding 120 → 118).

amendments.change: (a) Templater counts as a fallback on an in-request pick; (b) honest-empty requires a turn that ran and reported NoneFound; (c) unrun turns are scored as failed turns with failed checks, and a failed turn scores precision 0; (d) act is no data for an engine that emits none (v1) instead of being inferred from turn position; (e) failed and unrun turns are charged the client cap in latency; (f) latency gates also require every build slot held for the run; (g) mediaFilterViolations (picks against the request's own media filter) is gated; (h) compare refuses runs with different scenario fingerprints, turn counts, snapshot or artifact, compares counts paired over turns that ran in both runs, charges newly failed turns, and treats a metric the baseline measured but the run did not as a regression; (i) hedging covers the 'though … less / rather than' family and non-Latin script in English copy is counted
amendments.reason: Independent reviewers showed compare passing a run with scenarios removed (leaks 66 → 0), a 500 passing honest-empty, crashes raising act and lowering grounding/echo, timeouts improving p95, and v1's act 0.864 being a property of turn position. Each change makes failing worse, never better; none of them was chosen to move a baseline number.

amendments.dataSeen: the integration reviewer's keyless subset run on 7ee235b (IREV1-SYS-02, IREV1-SYS-06) and the three 99c0761 recordings
amendments.change: (a) degraded is read from done.degraded and assistant-message.degraded (the API never sends a frame named 'degraded'); a judge count of zero is not degraded; (b) the near-miss and unchecked trays on v1's done frame are recorded as shown cards, and exclusion leaks, ruled-out titles and grounding all count every tray, not only picks; (c) mustNotViolations is gated at 0; (d) missedSupply is gated at 0 and is now 'no pick while eligible titles clear the For-you bar' (eligible > 0 with nothing clearing the bar is an honest-empty check instead, the samurai case); (e) a none-found turn's done.supply is recorded and its alreadySeen, unscored and knockouts must equal the SQL supply truth (eval/askreel/supply/*.sql) exactly: supplyCountAccuracy gated at 100%; (f) the runner reads the mode v1 names on done
amendments.reason: A keyless run where every turn carried done.degraded=['no-model'] reported fallbackRate 0 and every gate passing, and a 'no superheroes' turn whose unchecked tray held 17 superhero titles reported 0 leaks and 0 ruled-out titles; 19/35 turns missed supply with no gate failing. Each change makes a failing run fail; none was chosen to move a baseline number. Effect on the 99c0761 baselines is in their re-scored metrics.json.

amendments.dataSeen: the round-2 integration reviewer's hand counts on the slot snapshot (ninja movies 70 matching / 18 seen at the vote floor; samurai 66 / 8) and the three 99c0761 recordings
amendments.change: (a) supply count accuracy also reads the REPLY's words (replySupply: the partition, the under-bar and unscored counts, each named relaxation) and compares every done.supply bucket, not only seen and unscored; (b) a named relaxation must equal the truth and no unnamed one may unlock more than the smallest named; (c) a none-found reply whose report says a partition or an unscored count was due but which states none the parser reads fails, so reworded copy cannot pass vacuously; (d) truth/samurai.sql no longer matches 'ronin' in a name (keyword arm unchanged) and its name arm is a whole word
amendments.reason: IREV2-SYS-03: the scorer never compared a reply's numbers with the truth, so a live golden run could neither pass nor fail the WS-2 acceptance, and the samurai truth counted Ronin (1998), a crime thriller with no samurai tag, putting the truth one over an honest reply. Each change makes a dishonest reply fail; the 99c0761 baselines re-score byte-identical (their v1 replies state no counts).

amendments.dataSeen: none: no judge verdict and no founder label exists
amendments.change: adds the judge section: kappaMin 0.6 on unweighted Cohen's kappa, the labelling set's provenance, and the two judge metrics that join the regression set once kappa clears
amendments.reason: Task 5. Registered before any data so the bar cannot be fitted to the first kappa, and so the judge cannot gate on the strength of its own unmeasured opinion.

amendments.dataSeen: the three h1 smoke recordings (h1-smoke-v1, -v2, -v2b) and their Titles rows: Joy Ride 2001 d324e481 vs 2023 82a439e0; Blade of the 47 Ronin c97485b5 vs 47 Ronin 6b46af62
amendments.change: grounding violations match a named title as a whole name with its own capitalisation, prefer the longest cited name over a name it contains, treat a name as on screen when any card shown this turn or earlier has the same normalised name, and count one name once
amendments.reason: HREV1-ASK-04 / HREV1-RET-03: both h1 grounding violations were scorer artefacts (a catalogue twin of an on-screen pick; a substring of an on-screen tray title), so the gate failed on correct output. Every remaining violation is a stand-alone mention of an off-screen name; the 99c0761 baselines re-score byte-identical and the h1 recordings change only on those two rows.

amendments.dataSeen: reports/hardening/h2/h2-smoke-v1-mislabelled-v2 (header engine v2, all 15 turns answered by v1) and h2-smoke-v2 (5 turns, all v2); no metric values
amendments.change: a recording's engine is the engine its answered turns name (the stream's conversation.engine / done.engine), not the --engine flag; a recording whose answered turns name another engine than requested, name none, or mix engines with none requested is INVALID: every gate reads INVALID, replay exits 1 and compare refuses it. The runner now asks for the engine (?engine=) and stops at the first mismatched turn
amendments.reason: HREV2-ASK-05 / HREV2-PLAT-3: the h2 smoke labelled 15 v1 turns as v2, so a G1 report could show v2 gates computed on v1 output. Validity only, no scoring rule moved: the 99c0761 baselines (v1 header, v1 turns) re-score to identical metrics

amendments.dataSeen: reports/hardening/h3/h3-smoke-v2-combined (no-conflict-control T1: reply 174 matching / 51 seen / 16 eligible / 4 clearing at 50 votes; ninja-critique T3 Clarify after two honest empties) and the 99c0761 open baseline's no-conflict-control and refine-recent rows
amendments.change: a turn's expect may carry `years` ({last: N} through the run's UTC year, or {from, to}); its concept truth, supply truth and missed-supply count are materialised inside that window under the key <concept>@<from>-<to>, undated titles passing. A turn whose windowed truth a recording never froze is reported truthMissing and scores no concept check. A reference with no referent (the earlier turn never showed that card) holds the turn to mode Clarify instead of its scripted act. no-conflict-control T1 gains years {last: 10}, refine-recent T2 years {last: 5}
amendments.reason: HREV3-EVAL-A / HREV3-RET-05: the all-years heist truth (487 / 124 / 33 / 11, MinYear 2000 unlocking 36) made a reply that equals the 2016–2026 truth on every bucket and knockout read as six count mismatches, a missing MinYear relaxation a 2016+ request cannot use, and 13 titles of missed supply. Re-materialised on reel_int_h3 (every frozen truth recomputed identically): supply counts pass on that turn, missed supply is 6 inside the window, not 13, and ninja-critique T3 passes as Clarify. The 99c0761 baselines cannot be re-materialised (their database and truth files have moved on: rematerialise refuses on 7 drifted truths), so their two windowed turns are truthMissing: open constraintPrecisionAt8 0.4673 (n 103) -> 0.4704 (n 101); every other metric is unchanged

amendments.dataSeen: reports/hardening/final/fix-golden-v2-2 (recording, report: missed supply 11, supply counts 0.677, ruled-out 2) and an 8-turn smoke on the same build family (space-isolation-chain, conflict-standup, refine-recent) whose SearchTurns.IntentJson showed the app's readings (space MaxYear 1999; stand-up MediaTypes [Show]; kidnapping thrillers = keyword kidnapping AND genre thriller, both media)
amendments.change: (1) missed supply subtracts the clearing titles an earlier turn of the conversation showed (picks and every tray), from a new frozen field clearingShown, or inferred for older recordings from earlier picks and unchecked cards only; (2) an optional expect.meant truth (with meantWhy) decides missed supply / honest-empty where the concept truth is the tag population the reply counts: ninja-meant, heist-meant, dinosaur-meant; (3) a turn whose media scope or meant truth the recording never froze is truthMissing instead of falling back to the Any scope; (4) scenarios: media added on 20 turns whose words name the medium, removed on 6 whose words name none; refine-recent -> kidnapping-thriller, conflict-animated-kids -> animated-for-kids; space-isolation-chain T2/T3 years {to: 1999}; fantasy-then-mind-benders T2 loses mustNot genre-fantasy; (5) truth files: space.sql is the app's space synonym group from a word start (name arm: 'space' only), martial-arts.sql's name arm reads 'martial arts' only; genre-fantasy.sql moved to the sealed holdout's truth (only the holdout uses it), kidnapping.sql deleted (unused)
amendments.reason: Every change is a correctness fix of what the request means, each justified per scenario in docs/ask-reel-eval.md ('Truth restatements of fix-golden-v2-2') and held by askreel-score.test.mjs, ConceptTruthParityTests (restated and meant truths against HardConstraintFilter / on fixtures) or StandInTruthSqlTests (generated genre lists of the two new composite truths). Verified on the eval copy: the new truths equal the app's own counts on the turns that failed (space <=1999 110/31/1/78, MinYear 28 and 27/27, MinYear 13; animated-for-kids 1,247/156/4/1,087, animation 189; kidnapping-thriller 2021-2026 69/24/0/29, Language 4, MinCrowdRating 14; martial-arts 523/367). No bar moved. Committed baselines re-scored: 99c0761 open constraintPrecisionAt8 0.4704 (n 101) -> 0.4503 (n 92), honestEmpty 0 (n 16 -> 11), modeAccuracy 0 (n 29 -> 24), mustNotViolations 63 -> 59, negationPrecisionAt8 0.942 -> 0.955, mediaMismatches 94 -> 91; latency constraintPrecisionAt8 0.4141 (n 35) -> 0.4263 (n 34), mustNotViolations 23 -> 19, mediaMismatches 34 -> 38 — every n drop is a turn whose new scope or truth the 99c0761 recordings never froze

judge.note: Pre-registered 2026-10-26, before any judge verdict or founder label exists (§4.12, WS-7 task 5). The judge (scripts/eval/judge.mjs: openai/gpt-6-luna at reasoning effort none, one call per top-8 card, sealed prompt) gates NOTHING until its agreement with the founder's 100 labels reaches kappaMin; below it, or until the labels exist, only the SQL truth gates.
judge.kappa: Cohen's unweighted kappa on the 0-3 'satisfies the request' scale over the founder's labelled items, every labelled item judged (judge.mjs kappa). The quadratic-weighted and relevant (>= 2) kappas are reported beside it and gate nothing.
judge.labels: eval/askreel/labels/founder-100.csv, drawn by judge.mjs items --seed 42 from the 99c0761 open baseline recording

whenGating.label: Share of judged top-8 cards that satisfy the request (>= 2)
